G1_unambiguity.justification: The power settings and the requirement that paired vehicles have one exactly double the other unambiguously enforce different settings of 1 and 2 for every listed pair.

G2_completeness.justification: The rewrite specifies the variable bounds, allowed settings, pair constraints, lexicographic tie-break rule, input format, output format, and impossibility condition.

G3_faithfulness.justification: With settings restricted to 1 and 2, requiring one setting to be exactly double the other is equivalent to requiring conflicting vehicles to receive different shifts, with all bounds and output requirements preserved.

G4_naturalness.justification: The scenario is coherent and readable, though it is somewhat overelaborate and uses awkward phrasing such as “up to exactly 200,000.”
